changelog:
- Initial release of Course Narration Studio.
- Turn lecture manuscripts and course slides into an organized, consistent lecture-by-lecture narration pack.
- Pilot-first workflow: finalize one lecture then expand to the full course after user approval.
- Ensures consistent teacher voice, pronunciation, and educational pacing across all lessons.
- Handles pilot approval, voice/cloning consent, pronunciation table, and full course narration in clear, ordered steps.
- Bundled with MCP client for all Beatra operations, supporting safe automatic updates.
summary: Turn lecture manuscripts and course slides into a lecture-by-lecture narration pack with one consistent teacher voice. This AI course narration studio and course voiceover studio organizes lessons, keeps term pronunciations consistent, and records a first lecture plus the remaining course as ordered lesson audio. Use it for course narration, training voiceover, lesson TTS, lecture TTS, AI course audio, lesson narration, elearning voiceover, teacher voiceover, knowledge product audio, and course text to speech.
